# Credits

## Music

"Crypto" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The victory track in `game/audio/music_victory.ogg` is
remixed from it by `tools/music/remix_crypto.py`: sped up, looped, and layered with
drums and synths. The same credit is shown in-game under Settings.

"Velvet Horizon" (the menu music, `game/audio/music_menu.ogg`) was generated by Newms
with an AI music generator from the "Night Sky Lounge" prompt and looped by
`tools/music/loop_track.py --intro`. It replaced "Nocturnal Menu"
(https://www.freemusic.ai/song/8gDPk9kFvR).

"Neon Pulse" (the fight and overtime loops, `music_fight.ogg` at 120 BPM and
`music_overtime.ogg` at 140 BPM, https://www.freemusic.ai/song/fWpO3tKXjn) were generated
by Newms on FreeMusic AI under its commercial licence and looped by
`tools/music/loop_track.py`. No attribution is required.
